# Project Overview
This project explores the Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist through a comprehensive Data Science workflow.

## Python — Jupyter Notebook
Interactive analytical workflow using Python and its Data Science ecosystem.
(Data_Science.ipynb)

## R — R Markdown
Statistical analysis and predictive modeling using the R programming language.
(Data_Science.Rmd)

## Python — Quarto
A reproducible analytical report using Python and Quarto.
(Data_Science.qmd)

## Analytical Workflow

1. Data Acquisition
2. Data Understanding and Quality Assessment
3. Data Preprocessing and Feature Engineering
4. Exploratory Data Analysis
5. Statistical Analysis
6. Predictive Modeling
7. Conclusion and Further Work
